# ISIT Europe

> European network of Institutes for Sustainable IT (Green IT), bringing together non-profit organisations in Belgium, France and Switzerland to reduce the environmental and social footprint of digital technology.

ISIT Europe was born in France in 2014 and now federates three national non-profits, together representing more than 290 member organisations (large companies, SMEs, local authorities, schools, universities, NGOs). The network's action is built on the "3P" principle of sustainable IT: People, Planet, Prosperity.

## Member organisations

- [ISIT Belgium](https://isit-be.org): Belgian Institute for Sustainable IT, think and do tank founded in 2020, 80+ members.
- [INR France](https://institutnr.org): Institut du Numérique Responsable, created in 2018, 170+ members, supported by the Nouvelle-Aquitaine Region, ADEME, the French Ministry of Environment and the Interministerial Digital Direction.
- [ISIT Switzerland](https://isit-ch.org): Swiss Institute for Sustainable IT, founded in 2021, present in French-speaking Switzerland, 40 members.

## Pages

- [Home](https://isit-europe.org/): network overview, mission, the three member institutes.
- [About](https://isit-europe.org/about.html): origin, mission, projects, and the open self-hosted website behind the network.
- [Legal notices](https://isit-europe.org/legal-notices.html): publisher information and privacy policy.
- [Accessibility declaration](https://isit-europe.org/accessibility-declaration.html): conformance status and accessibility contact.

Available in English, French, German, Italian and Spanish (language prefixes `/fr/`, `/de/`, `/it/`, `/es/`).
